title: Wolfram High School Summer Camp
text:
The Wolfram High School Summer Camp is a project-orientated camp for high-school students. This program is geared for students interested in math, programming, computational thinking, AI, Machine Learning, entrepreneurship, API implementation, hackathons, and tech innovation. All students will create and complete a unique project to be published by the end of the program.

Camp runs July 4-18th 2020 at Bentley University in Waltham, MA. Cost is $2350.00. Need based financial aid is available. This is a Mu Alpha Theta summer-grant eligible program.

Applicants must be age 17 or under as of July 18, 2020. International students are welcome.

Approximately 45 students will be accepted. Students are accepted on a rolling-admissions basis and applications will be closed once maximum enrollment is reached. The application contains a required problem set with a two-week deadline to submit.

http://education.wolfram.com/summer/camp/
